place._theme: Industrial dungeons; the delve marker set. THE PROBE'S ONE VARIABLE: the Ecliptic exclusive keyword required on the created place.

prose.name: Repairs: Runaway Plant F3 on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The <Place> has been running since its crew fled and somebody else moved in, and its owners say it won't last much longer.
prose.card: Private Contract. Shut down the runaway plant at the <Place> on <Planet>. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: The shutdown is running, and the plant has announced it over the speakers, politely, to everyone, including the people with guns. I need to keep the terminal safe until it finishes.
beats.name: Plant Control Terminal
say: Shutdown authorised. Estimated time to completion is several minutes. All occupants have been informed of the change, which was not my decision.

beats.objective: Defend the terminal during the shutdown
beats.journal: I held the terminal until the shutdown finished. The <Place> is cold.
say: Shutdown complete. All systems are cold, and the facility is safe.

broadcast: Visitor detected. This facility has been operating outside safe limits for thirty-one days, and a shutdown can be authorised from the control terminal. Please be aware that the facility is also occupied.
_speech: The plant's own control system on the site speakers (10-28). Wants a calm synthetic voice; the voice id is the old owners' until his ear picks one. No names, places, factions or currency.
